August 25, 2026

# Oxygen is now available on trial plan stores

DateAugust 25, 2026

FlagsUpdate

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[Hydrogen](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=hydrogen)

You can now deploy Hydrogen storefronts to Oxygen from [trial plan stores](https://www.shopify.com/free-trial). Previously, Oxygen hosting required a paid plan.

Note that trial plan stores don't include public environments, so deployment URLs always require a store login.

[Learn more about supported plans](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/headless/hydrogen/fundamentals#supported-plans).
